idea: Compute every coordinate from integer numerators, for example centre = (2i+1)/(2k) and side = p/q, evaluated once as a float. Then clamp centre ± side/2 into [0,1], and shrink each side by a relative 1e-13 only when a float check against the evaluator's likely tolerance fails. This removes accumulated rounding from repeated (i+0.5)*side products.
